findings.B2-R67-OPS-MANAGEMENT-COUNTRY-RELOAD-R13: Canonical gestiones persisted but disappeared after reload because product Ops query requires pais and created managements lacked pais. Fixed by enriching from linked policy/client and persisting pais/moneda/producto.
findings.B2-R68-RENEWAL-PROPOSALS-PREMATURE-CREAT: Propuestas created Ops work before the user completed/confirmed its management form. Fixed with explicit pre-create modal and no persistence until confirmation.
findings.B2-R69-DIRECT-RENEWAL-RECEIPTS-PREMIUM-R: Direct renewal could prefill Mensual + 1 receipt from inconsistent source cuotas. Fixed with a coherent frequency-derived default in the renewal UI; monthly custom receipt count remains editable under the approved engine contract, while fixed frequencies continue deriving their canonical count from frequency; premium components/IVA and live total preview are editable/visible.
findings.B2-R70-FIRM-RENEWAL-SUPPORT-R13: Firm-renewal document was an unconstrained text field that accepted placeholder text. Clarified as traceable insurer support and reject placeholder/too-short values.
findings.B2-R71-OPS-CHECKLIST-FEEDBACK-MODAL-R13: Ops modal closed on backdrop click, checklist changes lacked durable feedback, and renewal proposal management lacked compare/send/feedback path. Backdrop close disabled; checklist uses durable write + bitacora/notification; compare/send and feedback actions added.

manualUat.firmRenewalSupportMeaning: Documento o soporte oficial de la aseguradora con condiciones definitivas de renovación: PDF/documento de renovación, enlace de Drive, referencia documental o equivalente trazable. No es una nota libre.
manualUat.previewTestResidue: La póliza número 'prueba' creada por Paula durante UAT debe tratarse como dato de prueba y limpiarse de forma exacta antes de cerrar B2/promover.
manualUat.receiptRule: Mensual permite cantidad personalizada de recibos; frecuencias fijas conservan su cantidad canónica (Semestral=2, etc.). El formulario de renovación ya no hereda Mensual+1 de una fuente inconsistente.
